prompts.identity: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Vietnamese RPG METAL SWORDSMAN character atlas. Input images are STYLE references only. NEW male swordsman clearly BUFF and muscular, not a slender scholar: broad shoulders and chest, thick athletic upper arms, strong long thighs, defined forearms and a solid waist. Less bulky armour than the hammer fighter, but unmistakably more muscular than the Mage and Archer. Masculine handsome angular youthful face with focused eyes, silver-gray swept-back medium-short hair in a compact low tie, no giant fluffy ponytail. Ivory and charcoal sleeveless Vietnamese fantasy martial tunic, polished silver lamellar chest/shoulder pieces with antique gold engraved accents, cream waist sash, fitted dark trousers, leather boots and polished metal bracers. A single long straight double-edged jian sword, bright tempered silver blade with subtle gold geometric engraving, gold crossguard; dark scabbard on his hip, no bow or staff. Metal identity conveyed by material and controlled silver/gold palette, no spell VFX. Row 2 poses: low RIGHT sword-ready stance with two hands; RIGHT sword raised to begin a strong overhead cut; extended RIGHT finishing a powerful sword thrust with planted wide stance; RIGHT defensive sword guard diagonally across body. Show muscle and athletic blade handling, no feminized narrow waist or oversized baby head. Precisely EIGHT isolated FULL-BODY figures in a FOUR-column by TWO-row atlas of ONE IDENTICAL character with the same face, head/body size, costume and weapon in every cell. Row 1: idle FRONT/down, idle RIGHT profile, idle BACK/up away, idle LEFT profile. Row 2: four RIGHT-facing battle poses as specified. Entire weapon, boots and clothing must fit comfortably inside each equal cell with wide transparent gutters. Mild overhead orthographic sprite camera; consistent row ground baseline. Painterly 2.5D soft textured shading, fine material highlights, compact 3.5–4-head proportions, readable at 80px tall, matching the supplied Mage/Archer brushwork but much more muscular. No labels, text, grid lines, scenery, ground plane/shadow, particles, magical haze, checkerboard or opaque backdrop. REAL RGBA transparency outside the figures.
prompts.finalCore: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference image is the exact character design to PRESERVE: face, hair, muscles, costume, colours, weapon and all eight pose identities. Re-layout this same eight-pose sprite atlas into a PORTRAIT canvas with exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows, NOT four columns/two rows. Each cell is wide enough for its complete weapon; generous fully transparent gutters at least 40px between all silhouettes. Row 1: idle front and idle right. Row 2: idle back and idle left. Row 3: ready right and overhead attack preparation right. Row 4: finished attack right and defensive guard right. The adjacent weapon tips currently touch other characters: separate every figure completely and finish every weapon tip without any neighbouring body behind it. Preserve one consistent head/body scale and original strong muscular silhouette across all eight poses. Full feet and weapon must remain inside each cell with empty margins. No background, ground shadow, labels, text, gridlines or VFX. REAL alpha transparency outside every figure. Prefer portrait 1024 by 1536 or 1536 by 2048; wide cells and visibly clear spacing matter more than filling the canvas.
prompts.run: Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2.5D Vietnamese RPG RUNNING SPRITE ATLAS, real transparent RGBA. Input image is the EXACT character design, weapon, face, muscular body and costume to preserve. Exactly SIXTEEN isolated full-body running figures in FOUR columns by FOUR rows on a square canvas, preferably 2048x2048. Row 1: RUNNING RIGHT four successive phases; Row 2: RUNNING DOWN toward camera four phases; Row 3: RUNNING UP away from camera four phases with back visible; Row 4: RUNNING LEFT four phases. A real alternating stride: column 1 left leg forward/right leg back, column 2 passing feet, column 3 right leg forward/left leg back, column 4 airborne recovery. Same face/head and muscle/body scale throughout, consistently mild overhead orthographic camera. Each figure occupies only about 65–70 percent of its cell height; generous transparent space on ALL four sides, including below feet. Weapon held close to torso diagonally forward/down while running; complete weapon tip and all feet inside the SAME cell. Every silhouette must be disconnected from every neighbouring pose, at least 30px of fully transparent gutter. Keep the original masculine strong body and broad shoulders in ALL directions, not a slimmer mage body. Refined soft painterly shading and metal/fabric texture consistent with Archer/Mage. NO text, labels, grid lines, floor, shadow, environment, spell VFX, haze or opaque background. Actual alpha transparency outside each figure. Character-specific invariants: a long straight silver jian with gold guard and dark hip scabbard; compact silver-gray swept-back hair; ivory/charcoal sleeveless tunic, polished silver/gold light armour, thick athletic chest and arms.

layout.core: 2 columns x 4 rows: idle down/right/up/left, ready/windup/strike/guard
layout.run: 4 columns x 4 rows: right/down/up/left, four phases each

runtime: 160 x 112 logical pixels, resolution 3, foot anchor (80,104). Fixed body scale; complete silhouette extraction.
scope: Character art + rehearsal preview; gameplay skills and balance not implemented.
